Anya R: Bringing Nautilus7b through onboarding. Quick smoke shows weird split on ZWJ sequences and a downstream rotary drift after int4 quant.
Diego: Example?
Anya R: tiny repro:
`input = 'Sanjay‍Kumar visited.'`
tokenized -> ['Sanjay', '‍', 'Kumar', ' visited', '.']
Weird to see U+200D as its own token in Nautilus vocab.
RuntimeBot: If token ids insert mid-context, kv-cache indexing and rotary sine/cos alignments can get mismatched. Did convert assume normalization?
Diego: Our convert script used positional map; it didn't handle explicit control-char tokens. Nautilus exporter kept explicit ZWJ entries and also set `rotary_freq_scale: 0.98` in metadata.
QA-Bot: Observed regression in long-context retrieval tests after int4: answer accuracy drops and more off-by-entity hallucinations.
Anya R: Quick temp fix: wrap tokenizer to normalize NFC before encode so the control char merges. Local smoke: some hallucination counts improved but worried about breaking Indic ligature behavior.
Diego: Better fix: converter should build name->id mapping and detect control-char tokens explicitly. If target lacks them, do deterministic remap (map to adjacent subtokens) rather than relying on index offsets.
RuntimeBot: Also we can honor `rotary_freq_scale` in loader: rescale precomputed sin/cos tables by 1/0.98 at load time. I ran a tiny int4 smoke with that and accuracy improved ~18%.
QA-Bot: Actionables?
Diego: 1) Add control-char detection & remap unit tests to llm_convert. 2) RFC for tokenizer normalization policy evaluating multilingual impact. 3) Loader toggle to apply rotary_freq_scale from model metadata. 4) Add ZWJ/ZWNJ examples to longctx eval set.
Anya R: I'll open the convert PR and the RFC. Will run int8 calibration before int4 to capture scale offsets as recommended.
RuntimeBot: I'll add the loader toggle behind onboarding flags and a deterministic rescale path.
QA-Bot: Filing regression ticket and adding prompt-set for Indic names.
Anya R: Summary: root cause looks like explicit ZWJ/ZWNJ token in Nautilus vocab + convert positional mapping assumption + non-default rotary_freq_scale -> quantization magnified phase drift. Plan: conservative remap + runtime rescale + expanded evals.
